summary.zh: 食物是维持学生状态的重要资源。和平阶段可以通过食堂和小卖部购买，暴露战争阶段则需要控制食堂或小卖部等供应点。
summary.en: Food is an important resource for maintaining student condition. In peacetime it can be bought from the cafeteria and shop; during open conflict, supply points such as the cafeteria or shop must be controlled.

items.zh: 食物会影响学生压力、支持率和长期行动承受能力。
items.en: Food affects student pressure, support, and the ability to endure long-term actions.

items.zh: 食物供应稳定时，组织更容易维持成员状态。
items.en: Stable food supply helps the organization maintain member condition.

items.zh: 食物短缺会让校园局势更容易恶化。
items.en: Food shortages can make campus conditions deteriorate more easily.

items.zh: 和平阶段，食物可以在食堂购买。
items.en: In peacetime, food can be bought from the cafeteria.

items.zh: 和平阶段，食物也可以在小卖部购买。
items.en: In peacetime, food can also be bought from the shop.

items.zh: 价格、供应量和随机事件可能影响购买效率。
items.en: Price, supply, and random events may affect purchase efficiency.

items.zh: 当局势进入暴露战争阶段，普通购买可能不再稳定。
items.en: When the conflict becomes open, ordinary purchasing may become unstable.

items.zh: 玩家需要通过占领食堂获得稳定食物来源。
items.en: The player may need to occupy the cafeteria to secure food supply.

items.zh: 玩家也可以通过控制小卖部获得食物。
items.en: The player can also gain food by controlling the shop.
